item.title: Software Engineer
item.author: sirichiu8632@gmail.com (Siri Chiu)
item.description: At Advantech, my software engineering work spans server thermal control, repeatable stress testing, rack observability, and quality tooling with explicit evidence and write gates. Across these projects, I turn fragmented hardware signals and manual procedures into workflows that can be traced and inspected.

item.title: Rack Monitoring System Development
item.author: sirichiu8632@gmail.com (Siri Chiu)
item.description: This rack-monitoring system handles the protocol and vendor-MIB differences among server BMCs, switches, and PDUs. A Golang collector gathers data through IPMI/SNMP, normalizes it into Prometheus metrics, and gives Grafana a unified source for equipment status and threshold alerts.

item.title: Intelligent Automated Stress Testing: Target-Power Modeling and Multidimensional Result Analysis
item.author: sirichiu8632@gmail.com (Siri Chiu)
item.description: This project is a distributed server stress-testing system built around Golang agents and a controller. It uses pre-tests to model component load-to-power responses, estimates a workload mix for a target wattage, preserves telemetry and logs during execution, and presents long-duration results through Grafana with an optional AI-assisted review path.

item.title: Server Cooling Control Algorithm: Automated PID Parameter Generation System Based on Steady-State Thermal Profiles
item.author: sirichiu8632@gmail.com (Siri Chiu)
item.description: This project connects an environmental chamber, server BMC, and automation controller in a test loop. It first builds a steady-state thermal profile, then derives PID parameters from profile slope and system gain. The method addresses both time-consuming manual tuning and integral-state behavior that can cause RPM undershoot or oscillation after a load dump.
